questions.question: Which is the largest country in the world by area?
questions.explanation: Russia is HUGE — it covers 11 time zones and is twice the size of the USA! 🗺️

questions.question: Which is the longest river in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile in Africa stretches 6,650 km — though Amazon has more water volume! 🌊

questions.question: Which continent has the most countries?
questions.explanation: Africa has 54 countries — more than any other continent on Earth! 🌍

questions.question: What is the smallest country in the world?
questions.explanation: Vatican City is only 0.44 km² — smaller than most parks! It's inside Rome, Italy! ⛪

questions.question: Which mountain is the tallest in the world?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest at 8,849m is Earth's highest peak — on the Nepal-China border! 🏔️

questions.question: Which desert is the largest in the world?
questions.explanation: Antarctica is technically the world's largest desert — it gets very little rain or snow! 🏜️

questions.question: How many continents are there?
questions.explanation: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Australia, Europe, North America, South America — 7 continents! 🌎
